extracted.name: Lemon Basmati Rice
extracted.description: This delicious and easy side dish goes great with fish!
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a pot over medium heat; add rice, ginger, and lemon zest and cook about 1 minute. Add lemon juice and chicken broth; bring to a boil. Cover the pot; simmer until liquid absorbed and rice tender, 18 to 20 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
